errors.text_span: die in alphabetischer Reihenfolge gelistet sind
errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not listed in alphabetical order. They are sorted in descending order based on the value of the bars.

errors.text_span: Deutschland, Dänemark, EU27, Frankreich, Italien, Japan, OECD, Polen, Schweden, Spanien, Südkorea und Vereinigte Staaten
errors.evidence: This list of categories does not match the chart. It omits 'Vereinigtes Königreich', incorrectly uses 'Vereinigte Staaten' instead of the label 'USA', and presents them in an incorrect alphabetical order instead of the order shown on the chart.
The bar for Frankreich (France) clearly reaches the 60% line, not 59%.
The bar for Südkorea (South Korea) is at 80%, not 78%.
The values for Dänemark (Denmark) and Deutschland (Germany) are approximately 79% and 78% respectively, which is significantly different from the reported 75%.
The value for OECD is approximately 72%, not 69%.

errors.text_span: Polen und die USA bei etwa 67%
errors.evidence: The values for both Polen (Poland) and the USA are at 70%, not 67%.

errors.text_span: Spanien und Italien bei etwa 64% bzw. 63%
errors.evidence: The values for Spanien (Spain) and Italien (Italy) are approximately 66% and 68% respectively. The reported values are inaccurate and also reversed in magnitude.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert, außer alphabetisch nach Ländernamen.
errors.evidence: This statement is false and contradictory. The bars are sorted in a specific order (descending by value), and this order is not alphabetical.
